locator.title: Трехсторонняя квартира: уникальный вид из каждой комнаты
locator.lead: Редкие форматы квартиры. Рассказываем, чем порадуют жителей в Level Мичуринский
locator.caption: Панорамные виды открываются на парки и скверы, МГУ имени М. В. Ломоносова и деловой центр «Москва-Сити».

current_heading.text: Три уникальных вида — в одной квартире

nearest_text_before.text: Жилой комплекс Левел Мичуринский предлагает редкий формат квартир с панорамными окнами сразу на три стороны. Проект окружен живописными локациями: зеленые заказники, набережные, доминанты столицы, а также многоуровневый двор с природным ландшафтом, видовым амфитеатром и балконами-гостиными. В трехсторонней квартире вы сможете наслаждаться всеми видами сразу.

nearest_text_after.text: Еще одно преимущество окон на три стороны — больше солнца. С раннего утра и до заката в квартире будет естественное освещение.

image_reading: A wide elevated panorama shows a large green park with winding paths, ponds and a visible fountain, surrounded by dense residential development.
The fountain spray, pond surface and tree canopy are the clearly movable elements; the distant skyline is softened by bright atmospheric haze.
analysis.article_context: The body image supports the section about three-sided panoramic windows by showing the broad green-and-city outlook available from the apartment, with parks and landscaped water in the foreground and Moscow’s residential skyline beyond.

structured_intent.editorial_meaning: The animation emphasizes the expansive combination of greenery, water and cityscape presented as an everyday panoramic view from the residential complex.
structured_intent.primary_action: A light breeze passes across the park, moving the tree canopy and carrying the fountain mist.
structured_intent.terminal_state: The fountain mist is visibly drawn into a soft rightward plume while the surrounding canopy retains a gentle wind-shaped movement.
structured_intent.semantic_invariant: The outlook remains spacious, tranquil and desirable, with the park and city continuously presented as one panoramic vista.

models.scene_plan: For the 3.2-second continuous shot, begin the breeze immediately at low amplitude, moving the treetops in a gentle coherent wave while the central fountain mist drifts slightly right and small ripples develop on the pond. Use one minimal, steady push toward the fountain as the focal target to add depth without losing the panoramic scale. Near the end, let the foliage motion soften while the fountain mist remains visibly shaped into a light rightward plume and the full green foreground and city skyline stay recognizable.
models.positive_prompt: A light breeze moves steadily across the park canopy and gently carries the visible fountain mist to the right as subtle ripples spread over the pond. Make a minimal slow push toward the fountain; by the final frames, the mist forms a soft rightward plume while the panoramic park-and-city view remains open and calm.
